MemeDef.label: wandering path
MemeDef.description: Every road is a master and every master is a road: no sect, no chains. Take a technique from an inn, a manual from a ruin and a lesson from whoever beat you, and owe nothing to anyone.

rulesStrings.li: creation(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_WanderingPath)->[deity0_name] left the first sect with nothing but a road, and found a master at every crossroads.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_CVG_Meme_WanderingPath)->[deity0_name] showed the first [memberName] that a road teaches more than a hall.
intro(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_WanderingPath)->The early [memberNamePlural] of the [place_summary] [place_name] met at inns and night markets and never at the same one twice.
conflict(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_WanderingPath)->A powerful [foeLeader] called the [memberNamePlural] thieves of techniques that belonged to the sects.
founderJoin(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_WanderingPath)->[founderName] shared a fire and half a manual with [memberName] on a cold night.
victory(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_WanderingPath)->[founderName] fought the [foeLeader] with the techniques of ten sects at once, and the [foeSoldiers] could not tell which to fear.
setup(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_WanderingPath)->The Iron Calamity destroyed the sects that had cast the believers out, and the road was all that was left.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_CVG_Meme_WanderingPath)->The believers spread out and grew in number, each walking a road of their own.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_WanderingPath)->Traveler, the old wanderers used to say:
lesson(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_WanderingPath)->every road is a master and every master is a road.
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_WanderingPath)->You will understand it at the thousandth crossroads.
archistFact(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_WanderingPath)->The archotechs never leave their halls; that is why they understand so little.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_WanderingPath)->[inTheEnd], every sect will fall, and the road will still be there.
animistFact(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_WanderingPath)->Every road keeps the footsteps of everyone who walked it.

IdeoPresetDef.label: wandering path
IdeoPresetDef.description: No hall, no master, no walls: the road is the sect. Everyone cultivates wherever they stand.
